anchors.paper_title: Affective Calibration of Musical Feature Sets in an Emotionally Intelligent Music Composition System
anchors.reason: Williams et al. 2017 covers listener-rated calibration of a music stimulus set in the same BCMI-MIdAS project; it does not describe this EEG dataset (Daly et al. 2018).

metadata.methods_description: EEG, GSR, and ECG data were recorded at 1 kHz sampling rate from 19 healthy adult participants during listening to synthetic music clips (40 s duration). Each clip targeted two affective states sequentially (first 20 s for state 1, remaining 20 s for state 2), with 5 runs of 18 music trials per session. The synthetic music clips were generated in real-time by a music generator based on target emotional states defined by valence (LOW/NEUTRAL/HIGH) and arousal (LOW/NEUTRAL/HIGH) dimensions. Participants provided self-reported valence and arousal ratings for each trial.
